authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11109 leṭyati gives Lahnda leṭaṇ, Punjabi/Western Pahari leṭṇā, Nepali leṭnu and Hindi leṭnā lie down. The selected bare leṭ and simple leṭa/leṭo responses use this stem; leṭṇā is an ordinary infinitive explicitly documented by the entry. Mixed imperative/past elicitation labels and source final vowels are retained. The proposed deeper non-Aryan connection and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain unresolved. Exact response: leʈo.
